title: Invention No. 1 in C major
short: Johann Sebastian Bach · C 4/4 · listen, then play it.
trouble: Reading notes one at a time instead of in chunks.

blocks.html: Bach wrote the Inventions to teach playing two independent lines. The whole piece grows from the short idea in bar 1 (C D E F D E C), which passes back and forth between the hands and is sometimes turned upside down. Practice each hand alone, then put them together slowly.

blocks.name: music-player
blocks.cap: Play it: the score scrolls, the keys light up, and “wait for me” lets you practise one hand at a time.

blocks.html: Play through it once with the right hand only, then add the left. Which chord change made you stop?

sources.name: Mutopia Project edition (Jeff Covey, from the Bach-Gesellschaft edition; the typesetting is CC BY-SA 3.0, the music public domain), compared with this file note by note by our checking script. The trills and mordents in that edition are left out.
